description: Curated CPU Scheduling workloads for Memora demonstration and benchmarking.

datasets.name: Standard Staggered Arrivals
datasets.description: Five processes arriving across time units 0 to 4 with varying burst times.

datasets.name: Simultaneous Arrival (Textbook Reference)
datasets.description: Classic textbook benchmark where all processes arrive simultaneously at T=0.

datasets.name: CPU Idle Gap Benchmark
datasets.description: Workload with an arrival gap between P1 and P2 causing CPU idle time.

datasets.name: Convoy Effect Scenario
datasets.description: One very long CPU-bound process arriving first, followed by several short I/O-like bursts.
